review_batches.context: Entire member read. Alternate Melvi/Ai awakenings and wrong-name reactions after two days; previous rift partner calls checked.
review_batches.decisions: Voice is a generic source label here, not proof of the library antagonist's identity. Keep all alternate calls/silences, familiar addresses, reassurance direction and two-day uncertainty. Non-explicit affection translated; no invented physical action.

review_batches.context: Leone's recovery, family revelation, accountability discussion, renewed alliance and Eleana's apparent invisibility.
review_batches.decisions: Keep control hypothesis, chance meeting versus deceit distinction, full Bafred/Sharl names, cannot versus must-not moral self-correction and Touya's past-tense ally argument. Eleana's spatial disengagement is distinct from simple transparency and ordinary communications.

row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o02e69.l00: Leone says she is healthy; mech damage is discussed separately later.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o02ed3.l00: Alternate why-are-you-here question remains separate from preceding variant.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o02ed3.l01: Looking-for-me guess is withdrawn by Leone, not confirmed by Touya.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o02f35.l00: Leone asks what she did, reflecting limited recall.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o02f59.l01: Yamato says Touya tried to persuade her, not that he failed to speak at all.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o02f92.l02: Warm feeling is remembered affection, not actual temperature measurement.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o02fe5.l00: Being controlled remains Yamato's inference; no controller identity/mechanism inserted here.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o02fe5.l02: Pretending ignorance is Yamato's accusation; Leone distinguishes chance meeting and valued memories in response.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o0304f.l02: Precious memory is a deliberate sentence continuation, not an omitted new predicate.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o030a5.l02: Yamato's concern for Leone trails off; no invented confession beyond source.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o030eb.l01: Needed by family is Leone's reported reason; their actual benevolence is not certified.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o0312c.l00: Dad? Sis? are deliberate echo questions.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o03149.l00: Full Leone Debish name revealed here as source states, though earlier narration/glossary already knows it.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o03149.l01: Canonical Bafred Debish and Sharl Debish preserved, along with father/sister relation.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o031e9.l02: Can't becomes shouldn't in Leone's moral self-correction; do not flatten into literal impossibility of all judgment.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o03248.l00: Yamato distinguishes change of belief from justification of past conduct; source typo rendered by clear intended justify meaning.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o032cc.l00: Past tense were is Touya's key membership correction, retained as quoted word.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o032f6.l02: Touya asks if Leone actively wants to stop them, not whether she merely disagrees.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o0335e.l01: We are teammates again restores both sides of renewed alliance; no future battle guarantee.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o033c2.l01: Can't hate you expresses forgiving affection; welcome back carries directed renewed partnership, not literal invitation to return to Ze=Ode.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o03418.l01: From your end asks Leone to use her own position/equipment, with no named scanner invented.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o03459.l02: Seems left behind remains tentative, not confirmed villains' motive.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o0349f.l01: Your mech is the movement referent, clarified by following Eleana functions; not a question about whether injured Leone can walk.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o034d0.l01: Following like this is potentially troublesome because recognizable mech would be visible; exact political consequence not invented.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o0354e.l00: Single quotes preserve source's changed communication style without adding a new speaker label.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o03563.l01: Yamato describes apparent transparency, then Leone corrects mechanism.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o035a2.l01: Its refers to Eleana's connection to Agarthian space, not deleting all of Agarthia. Source presents fictional spatial disengagement, not simple optical camouflage.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o035a2.l02: Same as not existing is a comparison in current space, not literal annihilation of pilot/mech.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o0362e.l00: Leone sends voice directly to listener rather than normal radio. No named telepathy power inferred.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o036a4.l00: Eleana's function, not Leone's personal power; preserve explicit correction.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o036a4.l02: Most other functions seem damaged, not every function certainly destroyed.

review_batches.context: Eleana's damaged field/jump functions, remaining travel, return plan and two armies' withdrawn front.
review_batches.decisions: Final twenty-nine rows retain damaged ability versus ordinary flight distinctions, remote-voice direction and reported visual/political observations. No invented invisibility technology, absolute invulnerability or confirmed enemy location.

row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o036a4.l03: Field generation is currently unavailable, not proof it never existed.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o03701.l01: Ordinary attacks barely work against field, not absolute immunity. Deliberately unfinished description.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o03742.l00: Jump function is a quoted short label, not necessarily an identical named ability/mechanism to every spatial jump earlier.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o0376c.l01: Takes normal damage is Touya's inference following field failure; not a new stat modifier.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o037a4.l00: Only normal flight remains for travel, distinct from spatial disengagement and direct voice.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o037fb.l01: Leone tells Touya to choose destination while she follows; don't reverse leader/follower.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o03871.l00: She is established female Leone, not inferred from name.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o039d0.l00: All right is a deliberately unfinished departure lead-in.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o03a09.l01: Two armies are identified tentatively by Yamato, not an exact count of units.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o03a42.l01: Front has fallen back this far is Touya's observation; no new victory/defeat report or geographic distance invented.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o03ace.l00: Lodis is inferred witness from previous proposal to meet him; must've seen remains inference.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01b.o03ace.l02: Touya intends to persuade Lodis to stop the war in light of Vorlia, not a claim he already succeeded.
